/adventurers/[luka]/story: A 16-year-old village boy who dreams of becoming a legendary hero. He's never properly swung a sword, yet he burst into the forge shouting, 'I'll dig up all the best materials!' A total scaredy-cat, but his bragging is legendary!
/adventurers/[garam]/trait/desc: +1 of a random material brought back
/adventurers/[garam]/story: 21, and once the village's best porter. Lifts anything, says almost nothing—unless he's hungry, then he won't stop talking. He draws a longbow with his hauling arms and finds arrows boringly light.
/adventurers/[sera]/story: A mid-20s scout from who-knows-where. One wink and she spots a shortcut, apparently. Handy with bow and blade alike. Life motto: 'Pack light, brag heavy!'
/adventurers/[gregor]/story: A 40-something veteran with 20+ years of battlefields behind him. Few words, but every one lands. Hobby: polishing an old armor plate. Tells the odd dad joke—only he laughs.
/adventurers/[torvin]/story: A dwarf warrior from a mining town. Iron rings in his braided beard, helmet lamp on even in his sleep. Gruff as a rock—until someone mentions ore. Then he talks all night.
/adventurers/[elarin]/story: An elf huntress from a distant forest. Long silver-gold hair, a green cloak, and she reads the weather in the wind. Slow to speak, lightning on the bowstring.
